LanguageData.LP_FleshIncubator.label: flesh incubator
LanguageData.LP_FleshIncubator.description: A flesh trough steeped in aberrant paste. Fill it with twisted meat: every 30 units hatches 1 friendly small flesh beast (a fingerspike) that obeys the colony and rots after 3 days; at most 4 at a time. Each one takes 6 hours to hatch.\n\nFoul-smelling and ugly: beauty -10 around it.
LanguageData.LP_FleshWall.label: flesh bulwark
LanguageData.LP_FleshWall.description: A wall "grown" from aberrant paste that keeps slowly pulsing. About as sturdy as a stone wall, regrows 10% health per day; vulnerable to acid (acid damage ×2). Can hold up a roof.
